summary: The corrective implementation substantially adds real bounded runtime paths for Phases 8–11 and preserves the existing Android/gateway boundaries. However, documentation still uses non-approved status vocabulary, and the full test suite could not be executed in this environment.

findings.evidence: These documents use statuses such as "functional local runtime", "functional local checkpoint", "functional automated capture/provider checkpoint", and "real Android APK", which are outside the required vocabulary.
findings.recommendation: Replace status declarations with only FOUNDATION ONLY, FUNCTIONAL — AUTOMATED VALIDATION COMPLETE, FUNCTIONAL — HUMAN VALIDATION PENDING, APPROVED, RELEASED, or BLOCKED.

findings.evidence: `pnpm test` could not complete: Node failed with `spawn EPERM` before the workspace test suites executed. No successful full Rust/TypeScript test evidence was available in this review.
findings.recommendation: Run the complete workspace and Rust/Tauri validation in an environment where child-process spawning is permitted, and record the actual results.

findings.evidence: Real device/provider behavior depends on Windows hardware and externally installed local executables configured through environment variables.
findings.recommendation: Retain as explicit human/external validation reservations; do not mark release-ready until supported Windows runtime checks complete.

validation_evidence: Reviewed all corrective commits in origin/main..HEAD.
Confirmed bounded Windows waveIn/waveOut enumeration, capture, playback, cancellation, provider degradation, and custom-reference validation.
Confirmed bounded workspace containment, link/reparse rejection, preview, approval, second confirmation, dry-run, audit, cancellation, and compensation paths.
Confirmed closed declarative Rust extension VM with integrity validation, capabilities, bounded host context, cancellation, lifecycle controls, rollback, and disable behavior.
Confirmed Windows GDI capture and bounded executable visual-provider protocol with timeout, cancellation, cleanup, and strict uncertain output.
Confirmed no corrective changes to the existing Android/gateway transport implementation and no BielOS coupling.
Publication searches found no obvious credential or private-data match.
Full local test suite not completed because of spawn EPERM.
human_validation: Filesystem confirmation UX and real Windows path behavior.
Extension usability and packaged desktop behavior.
Screen privacy, display behavior, and visual quality.
publication_readiness: Release artifact review required. No obvious secret was found in the inspected tree, but full history and generated artifacts were not independently scanned.
